_doc: Parity values of the confirmation, record and approval area (M3) for the reference operation. The integration merges them into tests/fixtures/presets/parity.json. third_party: the reference freezes a manually changed night for 7 days by time (ordens.registrar_manual); waves: 3 cancellations of one channel within 3 hours (vigia_seguranca), held until acknowledged; approval: the reference validates with a calendar of at most 6 hours (validar_plano --horas 6).
